project_name: The Housing News - Writing Desk Redesign

theme_and_archetype.description: A premium, editorial writing experience reflecting high-end real estate authority. Adopts Substack's layout patterns while retaining the existing cream, gold, and navy brand tokens.

fonts.display: font-display, Playfair Display, ui-serif, Georgia, serif

hierarchy.h1_editor_title: text-4xl sm:text-5xl font-display font-medium text-[#2C2410] tracking-tight leading-tight placeholder:text-[#2C2410]/30
hierarchy.ui_labels: text-sm font-body uppercase tracking-[0.1em] text-[#2C2410]/70 font-semibold

layout_grid.container: max-w-5xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-8 md:py-12
layout_grid.stats_row: flex flex-wrap md:flex-nowrap gap-4 mb-8 p-4 bg-white/50 backdrop-blur-sm border border-[#AD893E]/20 rounded-2xl shadow-sm
layout_grid.main_content: w-full bg-white border border-[#AD893E]/20 rounded-2xl shadow-sm overflow-hidden

dashboard_tabs.description: Tabs for Drafts / Scheduled / Published / Sent. Clean, minimal underline indicators.
dashboard_tabs.classes: flex space-x-8 border-b border-[#AD893E]/20 px-6 sm:px-8

stats_summary.description: Slim row of stats replacing the 5 massive cards.
stats_summary.item_classes: flex-1 min-w-[120px] px-4 py-2 border-l border-[#AD893E]/10 first:border-l-0
stats_summary.label: text-xs font-body uppercase tracking-widest text-[#2C2410]/50 mb-1

editor_anatomy.description: Title-first inline editor. Switches between Short Post and Essay.
editor_anatomy.tab_toggle: inline-flex bg-[#FDFAF4] rounded-full p-1 border border-[#AD893E]/20 mb-8
editor_anatomy.tab_button_active: px-6 py-2 rounded-full bg-[#1D2D44] text-[#FDFAF4] text-sm font-medium shadow-sm transition-all
editor_anatomy.tab_button_inactive: px-6 py-2 rounded-full text-[#2C2410]/70 hover:text-[#2C2410] text-sm font-medium transition-all

essay_mode.title_input: w-full bg-transparent border-none focus:ring-0 resize-none p-0 mb-4 h-14
essay_mode.subtitle_input: w-full bg-transparent border-none focus:ring-0 text-xl text-[#2C2410]/60 font-body placeholder:text-[#2C2410]/30 mb-8
essay_mode.body_textarea: w-full min-h-[400px] bg-transparent border-none focus:ring-0 resize-y

short_post_mode.body_textarea: w-full min-h-[150px] text-lg bg-transparent border-none focus:ring-0 resize-y

floating_toolbar.description: Appears on text selection in the editor. Substack style.
floating_toolbar.classes: absolute z-50 flex items-center bg-[#1D2D44] text-[#FDFAF4] rounded-lg shadow-xl px-2 py-1 space-x-1
floating_toolbar.button: p-2 hover:bg-white/10 rounded text-sm font-medium transition-colors cursor-pointer

publish_drawer.description: Right-side slide-in drawer for publish settings.
publish_drawer.container: fixed inset-y-0 right-0 z-50 w-full max-w-md bg-[#FDFAF4] shadow-2xl border-l border-[#AD893E]/20 flex flex-col transform transition-transform duration-300 ease-out
publish_drawer.overlay: fixed inset-0 z-40 bg-[#1D2D44]/40 backdrop-blur-sm transition-opacity
publish_drawer.header: flex justify-between items-center p-6 border-b border-[#AD893E]/10
publish_drawer.section_title: text-sm font-body uppercase tracking-[0.1em] text-[#2C2410]/70 mb-4
publish_drawer.schedule_card: bg-white p-4 rounded-xl border border-[#AD893E]/20 flex items-center justify-between cursor-pointer hover:border-[#AD893E]/50 transition-colors
publish_drawer.primary_cta: w-full py-3 bg-[#AD893E] hover:bg-[#967534] text-[#FDFAF4] rounded-full font-medium shadow-md transition-all flex justify-center items-center

interactions_and_motion.hover_states: Buttons subtly scale (-translate-y-px) and increase shadow. List items receive a subtle bg-[#AD893E]/5 treatment on hover.
interactions_and_motion.drawer_slide: Drawer slides in from the right: translate-x-full to translate-x-0 with 300ms ease-out. Overlay fades in with 300ms ease-out.
interactions_and_motion.floating_toolbar_pop: opacity-0 scale-95 to opacity-100 scale-100 with 150ms spring animation.
interactions_and_motion.tab_switch: Crossfade opacity between editor modes (Short/Essay) to prevent jarring layout jumps.

component_file_changes.instructions: Split the monolithic Composer.jsx to manage complexity introduced by the floating toolbar and drawer.
frontend/src/pages/Write.jsx: Update main layout grid: add max-w-5xl wrapper.
Replace the 5 KPI cards with a single slim flex-row stats summary.
Render the clean post list with rich rows (opens/views/sends metrics right-aligned).
frontend/src/components/Composer.jsx: Keep the Short Post / Essay toggle at the top of the component.
Implement adaptive UI: If Essay, show Title (`text-4xl font-display`) + Subtitle + Body. If Short Post, show only Body + 500 char counter.
Change the 'Queue for release' button to 'Next' or 'Publish Settings' which triggers the `onOpenPublishDrawer` prop instead of submitting directly.
NEW FILE: Listens to window.getSelection() within the composer.
Calculates bounding box of selection and positions itself absolutely above the selected text.
Contains formatting actions: Bold, Italic, Link, H2, Quote.
frontend/src/components/PublishDrawer.js: NEW FILE: A slide-in drawer from the right side of the screen.
Receives current post metadata and content as props.
Contains: Audience selector (Everyone), Schedule picker (Next drop 8:30 AM / 5:30 PM CT vs Custom), Email-on-publish toggle, Regions combo box, Attachments summary.
Contains the final 'Queue for release' / 'Publish now' CTA button that triggers the actual API submission.
